title: The sign-in screen
caption: Pick your name from the list, type your PIN on the keypad and press Unlock. A wrong PIN shakes and counts; repeated wrong PINs lock the account for a while.

title: Home before the day starts
caption: Today's four numbers are zero, the four everyday buttons are ready, and "Needs attention" already warns that 15.7 kgs Tin is below its low-stock level.

title: Step 1 — press New Bill
caption: The bill form opens with one empty item line and today's date.

title: Step 2 — pick the customer and an item
caption: Choosing "5 kgs Can" fills its fixed price 2,065 automatically. Quantity starts at 1.

title: Step 3 — quantities and more lines
caption: Three lines: 300 × 2,065, 300 × 1,037.5 and 40 × 6,535. Each amount and the subtotal update as you type. The amber note warns that only 45 tins are in stock.

title: Step 4 — change a price on one line
caption: The tin price was changed from 6,535 to 6,500 for this bill only; the item keeps its normal price for next time.

title: Step 5 — discount and payment
caption: A 2,150 discount brings the total to 1,190,000. "Full" fills Paid now with the whole amount; method is Cash. The footer confirms "Fully paid".

title: Step 6 — Save & Print
caption: The bill is saved as Invoice #1 and the printout opens: Bill From / Bill To, Description · Qty · Price · Amount, Subtotal, Discount, Total Rs., Paid, PAID IN FULL. Press "Print / Save PDF".

title: Result on Home
caption: Sales today 1,190,000, cash received 1,190,000, one bill in Recent bills, cash in hand went up by the same amount.

title: A bill on credit for a new customer
caption: Press "New" beside the customer box and type the name and phone — no need to leave the bill. 2 tins = 13,070; the customer pays 5,000 now, so 8,070 is shown "on credit".

title: The Bills list
caption: Both bills, newest first. INV-1 shows Paid; INV-2 shows "Rs. 8,070 due" in amber. Search, Today / 7 days / This month / All, Unpaid filter and CSV download are at the top.

title: Unpaid filter
caption: Only bills with money still due. Tap a row to open it.

title: Open a bill
caption: Lines, Total / Paid / Balance, what the customer owes across all bills, the payment already taken, and the Receive payment form.

title: Receive a part payment
caption: 3,000 by Easypaisa / JazzCash. The balance drops to 5,070, the payment appears in the list, and the message confirms what is still due. Bank balance goes up (Easypaisa counts as bank).

title: Receive the rest
caption: "Full" fills the remaining 5,070. The bill is now fully paid and the Receive form disappears.

title: Print a bill later
caption: Any bill can be printed again; this one now shows every payment and PAID IN FULL.

title: Customers list
caption: Every customer with phone and what they owe ("Clear" when nothing). The bill icon on a row starts a new bill for that customer. Gul Khan was created from inside the bill.

title: One customer
caption: Owes you, number of bills, bought so far, every bill (tap to open), money received, and the buttons: New bill, Statement, Edit, Delete.

title: Customer statement
caption: A printable statement of account for the year: opening balance, every bill and payment, running balance.

title: Add an expense
caption: From the Daily Sheet the "+ Food & refreshments" chip opens the form with the category and date already set. Fill what for, amount, and how it was paid.

title: Expenses on the sheet
caption: Three expenses in three sheets: Food (cash), Employee (paid from bank), Owner drawings (cash). Each sheet shows its own total. Cash out and Bank out tiles update.

title: Deposit cash to the bank
caption: Choose Deposit to bank or Withdraw cash; the buttons show what is in the drawer and in the bank right now. You cannot move more than you have.

title: The daily sheet after the deposit
caption: Closing cash fell by 1,000,000 and closing bank rose by the same. The deposit is listed once under "Suppliers paid, deposits & withdrawals".

title: Print the daily sheet
caption: Opening and closing for cash and bank, bills, money received, expenses by sheet, deposits — with Prepared by / Checked by lines. Print this at closing time.

title: Any earlier day
caption: The arrows or the date box show any past day. Yesterday is empty but carries the opening and closing balances.

title: Where the money is
caption: Cash in hand, in bank, customers owe you, you owe others, and "Money in business" with its formula. The debtor list has Receive and a statement printer per customer; the creditor list shows the supplier and the unpaid expense.

title: Opening balances
caption: The starting cash, bank and date that all balances count from. Set once on day one; change only if the count was wrong.

title: Receive against an account
caption: Money from a customer that is not tied to one bill (old dues). The dropdown shows what each customer owes; "Full" fills it. Overpaying is refused.

title: Monthly expense sheets
caption: One card per category for the chosen month: Owner drawings, Employee, Food… with every entry and its total.

title: Cash book
caption: Every rupee in and out this month, each with its method, plus In / Out totals.

title: The price list
caption: 15.7 kgs Tin is red: 45 − 40 − 2 = 3 left, below its warning level of 50. "Sold (all time)" counts every bill.

title: Add an item
caption: Name, sold per, fixed selling price, optional cost, stock on hand and the low-stock warning level.

title: Edit an item
caption: Pencil on any row. Here the tin stock is corrected to 60 after new stock arrived.

title: After the changes
caption: 1 kg Pouch is in the list and the tin is no longer red.

title: Suppliers
caption: Who you buy from and what you owe them. Record a payment to a supplier from here; it shows under "You owe others" on Money and in the cash book.

title: Users and PINs
caption: Add staff with a role: operator (bills and payments only), manager, admin. Change PINs. Deactivate old accounts.

title: System & Backups
caption: Master PIN, Export / Import backup, factory reset, the company profile printed on bills, App mode, opening cash and bank, CSV exports and table purges.

title: Audit trail
caption: Every bill, payment, expense, delete and setting change with who did it and when.

title: One tap to the full suite
caption: The navigation changes to Dashboard, Bookings, Customers, Suppliers, Products, Reports, Ops, Admin. Same data underneath.

title: Reports
caption: Daily & monthly, Sales analytics, Profit & Loss, Cash Book, Balance Sheet, Receivables aging.

title: Back to simple billing
caption: The sidebar button brings the simple screens straight back.
